description: Turns an installed Windows desktop app into one self-extracting installer you can run on another PC, even from a dead drive, a disk image or an old Windows 7 PC, when the installer is gone.
notes: WinAppMigrator asks for administrator rights when it starts. It keeps its settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\WinAppMigrator, and its logs and the records that let the apps it installed be uninstalled in %ProgramData%\WinAppMigrator; uninstalling it leaves both.
